entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So we've arrived at the diner...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I've heard all about the unlimited[n]fountain drinks at these places...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Well...? Where are they? I don't see 'em[n]anywhere!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: [lName]?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Oh crap, and you're with a girl?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Is this a friend of yours?
He's in my class.
Friend might be a bit much.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hmmm. How 'bout I ask him to help[n]with my promise?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: What promise?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: W-Wellll...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...You just want to have a regular old[n]conversation?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: So, wait. You're saying that you,[n]a girl... want to talk to... me?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I see. In that case, I guess I don't have[n]a choice. Nope, none whatsoever. I'll just[n]have to help you out.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oooh, you're so nice!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: My name's Futaba Sakura, and don't you[n]forget it!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: U-Uh, okay...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm Yuuki Mishima, but everyone just[n]calls me Mishima...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hrmhrmhrm. It seems like help always[n]comes my way when I need it most.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Maybe my luck stat's really high.
I think you're right.[clr 27]
No.
Your... what?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Heck yeah! I could prolly roll a natural[n]twenty right now if you asked me to!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: O-Oh... Maybe I should take another look[n]at my stat sheet...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: My luck! Do you know about stats?[n]They're like points that represent[n]particular aspects of your being.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: How about you, Nishima? Are you into[n]this kinda stuff?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It's actually Mishima...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...So you want to learn more about[n]our generation? I doubt it'll be easy[n]to explain...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Youth... The unknown frontier...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Hm, maybe I should try talking about[n]my hobbies...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Do you like computers?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mm, I'm always online.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Me too!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: What sites do you use? I usually keep to[n]forums myself...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Or are you more into streaming? I'd[n]gladly subscribe to your channel.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: W-W-Wait, do you by chance run one of[n]those... racy channels?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: You'd need to be super courageous to[n]do that, though it certainly wouldn't be[n]unwelcome... Kek.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whoa, that's the first time I've heard anyone[n]actually say that out loud... Kek!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: H-Huh? That's all you took[n]from that conversation?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ah, I've got it!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This overwhelmingly forgettable[n]appearance, generic speech style,[n]and total lack of sex appeal...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Nishima... Are you an NPC!?
What's an NPC?
Savage.
He's the protagonist.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I dunno how to explain it...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's like... Oh! It's like he's a random extra[n]in a movie! No relevance whatsoever!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Do you really need to repeat yourself?[n]It was painful enough the first time[n]around...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: And my name isn't Nishima...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But it'd be even more savage to lie about[n]what he is!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And besides, NPCs are an important[n]piece in the jigsaw puzzle of gaming!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: You're not making this any better!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: And more importantly, my name[n]isn't Nishima!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Really?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Huh, I guess you can't judge a book[n]by its cover...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Anyway, I'm glad you spawned here!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I killed two promises with one Nishima[n]today!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: "Learn about my generation" and[n]"have a normal conversation with[n]a stranger my age"! Aw yeah!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I think I gained a ton of EXP on this[n]adventure.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And it's all 'cause you brought me here,[n][fName]. Thanks!
I can sense Futaba's[n]innocent joy...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: S-Sooo, um... Futaba-chan. It's okay if[n]I call you that, right? I'm a little[n]embarrassed, hahaha...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Anyway, uh... what are you doing[n]after this?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Going home.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: O-Oh... Right...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: C'mon, [fName]! We're off!
